No new dependency in package.json; the only new non-relative imports are lucide-react icons and react. The first load was 87.7 KB when the per-chunk budget was decided the same day
nodes.method: node web/build.mjs at each commit in a detached worktree, read dist/build.json (gzipBytes, firstLoadGzipBytes, entryGzipBytes); git diff 5b34b88..afccbb4 of package.json files (no change) and of product/web/src for new bare-module imports

nodes.title: The all-chunks bloat tripwire goes from 240 to 260 KB gzip: the 240.6 KB CI failure on 7dbca0a is feature growth in lazy screens across six commits, no library and no duplication. The first-load gate (100 KB) stays and is the real risk at 99.5 KB
nodes.rationale: decision.2026-10-24.web-budget-per-chunk made the total a tripwire for a library pulled in or code duplicated across chunks (tens of KB at once), raised only with the measured cause. The cause is measured (measure.2026-10-24.web-bundle-growth-afccbb4): +7.2 KB in one day over six feature commits, each a few KB, with no new dependency. 260 still trips on a library-sized jump.
nodes.reverse_if: A single commit adds 10 KB or more to the total, or a new dependency appears in the bundle; then find and remove the cause instead of raising the line. Also reverse if a measured cold lazy-route transition on a mid-range Android over throttled 4G exceeds 1 s.

nodes.title: The first load is 99.5 KB gzip against its 100 KB gate (it was 87.7 KB earlier on 2026-10-24): the next statically imported feature fails CI. Move statically imported code out of the entry into lazy chunks
nodes.closes_when: firstLoadGzipBytes is at most 90 KB at head with the browser flows green
